_comment: C-first continuation frozen from run-1q2kuC only: the first two Space keys produced `Unknown command ' '` and no RNG before the first movement, so this recipe removes those two non-actions and keeps the same independently chosen seed/date and terrain route. Move west to A, create a pit, move west to B, create a pool, wish a digging wand, return east into the pit, and zap west toward the pool. C source establishes the intended route: trapped TT_PIT sets pitdig; the adjacent pool yields a non-ROOM fillholetyp(..., TRUE); zap_dig calls pit_flow, which sets the square's liquid terrain and invokes liquid_flow. The C recording must confirm each actual step; this frozen recipe makes no claim about the later branch before recording.
